run_multiplex_client: run the gRPC multiplex client that makes both Greeter and RouteGuide RPCs on localhost:50051
create_route_note: create a RouteNote message with a text message and latitude/longitude location coordinates
get_route_feature: get a single RouteGuide feature at a specific latitude and longitude point from the server
list_route_features: list all RouteGuide features within a rectangular bounding box defined by two corner points
record_route: record a route by streaming random feature locations and receive a summary with points, features, distance, and time
